# Database Connection Failure

If the connection to the database fails when attempting to register the repository, this could result in the inability to create or update a repository, leading to a failure in the initialization process.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.register_repository`

- [knowledge_compiler.storage.db](../component/knowledge-compiler-storage-db.md)
